title: 搜索推荐系统
summary: 输入商品名与搜索词；每输入一个字符，返回字典序最小的至多三个、以当前前缀开头的商品。
insight: 先排序商品。每个前缀用 lower_bound 找到不小于它的首个商品，从该处向后检查最多三项是否具有此前缀。
pitfalls: 不存在匹配时返回空列表
排序后同一前缀商品连续

solutions.title: 排序后二分前缀起点
solutions.idea: 对每个递增长前缀定位连续匹配区间开头。
steps: 逐字符构造 prefix，对 products 二分第一个>=prefix 的位置
从位置起取至多三个 startsWith(prefix) 商品加入该层，汇总返回

code.java: class Solution { public List<List<String>> suggestedProducts(String[] products,String searchWord){Arrays.sort(products);List<List<String>> answer=new ArrayList<>();StringBuilder prefix=new StringBuilder();for(char ch:searchWord.toCharArray()){prefix.append(ch);int left=0,right=products.length;while(left<right){int middle=(left+right)/2;if(products[middle].compareTo(prefix.toString())<0)left=middle+1;else right=middle;}List<String> suggestions=new ArrayList<>();for(int i=left;i<products.length&&suggestions.size()<3&&products[i].startsWith(prefix.toString());i++)suggestions.add(products[i]);answer.add(suggestions);}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun suggestedProducts(products:Array<String>,searchWord:String):List<List<String>>{products.sort();val answer=mutableListOf<List<String>>();var prefix="";for(ch in searchWord){prefix+=ch;var left=0;var right=products.size;while(left<right){val middle=(left+right)/2;if(products[middle]<prefix)left=middle+1 else right=middle};val suggestions=mutableListOf<String>();var index=left;while(index<products.size&&suggestions.size<3&&products[index].startsWith(prefix))suggestions.add(products[index++]);answer.add(suggestions)};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: vector<vector<string>> suggestedProducts(vector<string>& products,string searchWord){sort(products.begin(),products.end());vector<vector<string>> answer;string prefix;for(char ch:searchWord){prefix+=ch;auto start=lower_bound(products.begin(),products.end(),prefix);vector<string> suggestions;for(auto it=start;it!=products.end()&&suggestions.size()<3&&it->rfind(prefix,0)==0;++it)suggestions.push_back(*it);answer.push_back(suggestions);}return answer;} };
